headline: Checking Seasonal Access at Oxford Island
reservation: Access to the Oxford Island peninsula is generally open for trail use, though the Discovery Centre maintains its own operational calendar. Visitors should verify current opening status for the onsite restaurant and educational facilities directly with Armagh City, Banbridge and Craigavon Borough Council. No overnight permit is specified in source materials.

days.title: Southern Shores and Nature Trails

stops.name: Oxford Island
stops.detail: Explore four miles of woodland trails and bird watching hides within this National Nature Reserve. Visit the wildflower meadows and boglands to experience the unique biodiversity of the Lough Neagh shoreline.

days.driving: Allow 15-30 minutes for local transfers; conditions vary by weather.
days.note: Suggested pacing allows for bird watching and trail exploration at a leisurely speed.

intel.title: Facility Access
intel.text: The Discovery Centre serves as the primary hub for environmental education and local history. Check locally for specific restaurant hours and accessibility within the reserve's boglands.

intel.title: Wildlife Viewing
intel.text: Morning visits are recommended for the bird hides to maximize wildlife sightings in the meadows and ponds. Woodland trails may be more crowded during weekend peak hours.

intel.title: Connectivity Gap
intel.text: Mobile signal strength throughout the nature reserve is not documented in official sources. Download maps prior to arrival at the peninsula.

intel.title: Local Services
intel.text: There are no fueling stations within the nature reserve boundaries. Ensure supplies are secured in nearby gateway towns like Lurgan before heading to the shore.

intel.title: Arrival Points
intel.text: Evidence does not specify exact parking capacity or overflow locations for Oxford Island. Arrive early during summer months to secure a space near the Discovery Centre.

plan.arrival: Collect a rental vehicle in Belfast or local transit hubs; proceed to the southern shore for supply pickup in Craigavon before entering the reserve.
plan.vehicle: Standard vehicles are suitable for access roads; check local restrictions for larger RVs on narrow peninsula paths.
plan.goldenHour: Lough Neagh shoreline views are best at sunset, though visibility is season-dependent.
